title: announce (server to Nunki)
description: Say this in the hall now: a canned announcement (`canned`, which the device words in its own language) or free text (`text`, said as it is). Either one is enough; with both, a device that knows the canned key says that and one that does not says the text. `id` is made by the server for each announcement, so a frame delivered twice is said once.

canned.description: silence: silence please; phones: switch off mobile phones; seats: take your seats; results: hand in your results; arbiter: please come to the arbiter's desk.
